scale.data_values: JetBrains Mono, 1.25rem to 2rem for big stats, 0.875rem for inline data, font-weight: 700

typography.hierarchy_rules: Never center-align long text. Use optical alignment for numbers (tabular-nums).

visual_enhancers.ambient_glows: Positioned absolutely (.ambient-glows). Use pure CSS radial-gradient (e.g. `radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(139,92,246,0.15) 0%, transparent 60%)`). Do not over-saturate. Give them a slow, subtle pulse animation.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a pseudo-element over body with a faint noise pattern (opacity 0.02) to break digital flatness.

mobile_responsive.sidebar: Transform into bottom navigation bar: position: fixed, bottom: 0, left: 0, width: 100%, height: 70px, flex-row, justify-around, background: rgba(10,10,15,0.9), backdrop-filter: blur(24px). Hide text (.tab span), show icons only.
mobile_responsive.grids: Force .stats, .admin-stats-grid, .bento to grid-cols-1 or grid-cols-2 depending on data density.

layouts.spacing: Use E1 Spacing: generous gaps. .section-header margin-bottom: 2rem. .tx-card padding: 1.5rem.

stat_cards.design: Glassmorphism base. Align label (.stat-label) left/top, value (.stat-val) bottom. Hover effect: translateY(-3px), intensify box-shadow to include a subtle colored glow based on context.

history_cards.design: Display as a compact row on desktop, stack gracefully on mobile. Use JetBrains Mono for PAN (.tx-pan), EXP (.tx-exp), CVV (.tx-cvv). Add subtle divider lines between segments (`border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)`).

badges_and_chips.design: Pill shape (border-radius: 99px). Solid high-contrast text, semi-transparent background (10-15% opacity), 1px solid border at 30% opacity of the same color.

inputs_and_toggles.design: Deep inset fields: background rgba(0,0,0,0.4), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), rounded-lg. Focus state: border-color var(--accent-purple), box-shadow 0 0 0 2px rgba(139,92,246,0.2).
inputs_and_toggles.toggles: .toggle-slider needs a distinct ON state (background: var(--accent-purple)) and OFF state (background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1)).

buttons.design: Primary: Vibrant gradient (purple to pink) or solid purple. High contrast. Rounded-xl. Hover: filter brightness(1.1) and translateY(-1px). Active: translateY(1px).

news_feed.design: Glass card, add left accent border (e.g., 3px solid pink for .news-item.alert). Font for title: Outfit, semi-bold.

motion.hover_states: All clickable elements (.tab, .btn-action, .tx-card, .saved-bin-row) must have a fast (0.15s) transform and color transition.
motion.tab_switching: When panels (.tab-panel) become active, trigger a CSS animation `@keyframes fadeSlideIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glass meets WCAG AA (at least 4.5:1). Darken glass backgrounds if necessary.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible `:focus-visible` outline. Never use `outline: none` without a visual fallback.

instructions_to_main_agent: Your objective is to modify `/app/semex/popup/dashboard.css` to achieve a top 1% E1-level aesthetic.
CRITICAL: Do NOT alter any HTML or JS files. You must target the existing classes and IDs.
Implement the E1 Glassmorphism style: high blur, subtle 1px translucent borders, and soft glowing ambient shadows.
Ensure perfect Mobile/Android responsiveness. Use media queries (`@media (max-width: 850px)`) to collapse the sidebar into a fixed bottom navigation bar and stack columns vertically.
Refine typography strictly: Outfit for headings/brands, Inter for body/labels, JetBrains Mono for all numeric data/BINs/IPs/Stats.
Elevate empty states (`.empty-state`, `.news-empty`) with subtle iconography and centered layout, utilizing opacity for depth.
Enhance the toggle switches, inputs, and dropdowns to look premium with inset shadows and distinct focus rings.
Verify that the layout remains a full-page dashboard (`height: 100vh`, `overflow: hidden` on body, `overflow-y: auto` on main content area).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects (24-32px blur).
DO NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, and crisp typography separate good from extraordinary.
